newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Greek Cypriot soldier hurt in mystery shooting.
newsitem.headline: Greek Cypriot soldier hurt in mystery shooting.

text.p: A Greek Cypriot soldier was found wounded from a gunshot on Saturday in a post near the ceasefire line dividing the island but the circumstances of the incident were unclear.

Army officials told Reuters the soldier, whose name was not disclosed, was found by other soldiers at 5.20 a.m. (0220 GMT) at Avgorou village in southeastern Cyprus. The soldier has been taken to hospital.
"The circumstances of the incident are under investigation," a defence ministry official said.
Cyprus radio reported the shooting was probably accidental.
The observation post is not far from one manned by Turks and Turkish Cypriots in the northern part of the divided island.
Two weeks ago a Greek Cypriot from Avgorou was fatally shot by Turkish forces after he wandered across the buffer zone looking for snails.
The island has been split between Turkish Cypriots and Greek Cypriots since 1974, when Turkish troops invaded after a coup on the island backed by the military regime then ruling Athens.
